info.title: Karzoun WhatsApp API
info.description: The Karzoun WhatsApp API, built on the WhatsApp Business Platform. One API key per phone number; endpoints never take a phone number ID or account ID.

post.description: Set one URL on the account's numbers. `override_all: false` only fills numbers without a URL.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST https://waba.karzoun.chat/waba_webhook \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Karzoun-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{
  "url": "https://example.com/whatsapp/webhook",
  "override_all": true
}'
